cards.front: What does the architecture diagram show flowing from React App through API Gateway?
cards.back: It shows flow to three microservices connected to Databases and Spring Cloud infrastructure.
cards.source_note: Architecture diagram titled 'Microservices Architecture using Spring boot and Spring Cloud' shows flow from React App -> API Gateway -> three microservices (Employee Service, Department Service, Organization Service) -> Spring Cloud infrastructure, with Databases below the services.

cards.front: Three core backend microservices are _____, Department Service (green), and Organization Service (dark blue), all connected to a shared Databases block and routed through the API Gateway.
cards.source_note: Three core backend microservices are Employee Service (red), Department Service (green), and Organization Service (dark blue), all connected to a shared Databases block and routed through the API Gateway.

cards.front: What supporting infrastructure is shown on the right of the diagram?
cards.back: It includes GitHub, Config Server, Service Registry, Spring Cloud Sleuth, and ZIPKIN for configuration, discovery, and tracing.
cards.source_note: Supporting infrastructure on the right includes GitHub at top, plus Config Server, Service Registry, Spring Cloud Sleuth, and ZIPKIN, indicating centralized configuration, service discovery, and distributed tracing.

cards.front: Inter-service communication will be demonstrated using three approaches: _____, WebClient, and SpringCloud Open Feign, highlighted by a red overlay arrow pointing between API Gateway and the services.
cards.source_note: Inter-service communication will be demonstrated using three approaches: RestTemplate, WebClient, and SpringCloud Open Feign, highlighted by a red overlay arrow pointing between API Gateway and the services.

cards.front: What pattern will be implemented using Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server?
cards.back: The service discovery pattern will be implemented using Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server.
cards.source_note: Service discovery pattern will be implemented using Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server, shown as a red overlay labeled Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server pointing to the Service Registry area.

cards.front: Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server is presented as a very essential pattern to avoid _____, enabling service registry and discovery for microservices.
cards.source_note: Spring Cloud Netflix Eureka Server is presented as a very essential pattern to avoid hardcoding hostname and ports, enabling service registry and discovery for microservices.

cards.front: What does Spring Cloud Config Server do?
cards.back: It externalizes the configurations of all microservices into a central Git repository.
cards.source_note: Spring Cloud Config Server is introduced to externalize the configurations of all microservices into a central place that is Git repository, with a red callout highlighting it over the microservices in the diagram.

cards.front: Why is a central component needed when a client calls different microservices?
cards.back: The client has to remember host name and ports of all microservices, so a central component solves this.
cards.source_note: When a client wants to make a call to different microservices, the client has to remember the host name and ports of all microservices, so the solution is a central component where a client can send a request to the central component.

cards.front: _____ is the implementation used to provide the API Gateway pattern in this microservices architecture, as highlighted by a red callout label pointing to the API Gateway in the diagram.
cards.source_note: Spring Cloud Gateway is the implementation used to provide the API Gateway pattern in this microservices architecture, as highlighted by a red callout label pointing to the API Gateway in the diagram.

cards.front: What is used together with Zipkin to visualize tracing log information?
cards.back: Spring Cloud provides the Spring Cloud Sleuth module to implement distributed tracing together with Zipkin.
cards.source_note: Spring Cloud provides the Spring Cloud Sleuth module to implement distributed tracing in the microservices project, used together with Zipkin to visualize tracing log information through a user interface that tracks trace information via a web application.

cards.front: The Circuit Breaker pattern helps avoid continuous calls to a down service: it returns a _____ to the client and sends a fallback response, preventing the API Gateway from repeatedly calling the failed Department Service.
cards.source_note: The Circuit Breaker pattern helps avoid continuous calls to a down service: it returns a default response to the client and sends a fallback response, preventing the API Gateway from repeatedly calling the failed Department Service.

cards.front: How many databases do the three core services have?
cards.back: Three core services — employee, department, organization — each have their own MySQL database.
cards.source_note: Three core services — employee, department, organization — each have their own MySQL database.
